answer:
Job 804416 did not run from main. Its project was the release-2026.08 branch at revision 71c0e4b9a2d63f58e1b07c4d9a3e26f8b5d10c97.

At that revision, ansible/roles_ocp_workloads/ocp4_workload_ledger_policy/files/ledgerpolicy-crd.yaml declares apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1beta1 (line 2), with the old single `version: v1alpha1` and `validation:` layout. The v1beta1 CustomResourceDefinition API was removed in Kubernetes 1.22 (OpenShift 4.9), so the cluster no longer serves it. That is exactly the "no matches for kind CustomResourceDefinition in version ..." error your teammate pasted.

The file on main is different. It is already fixed on main: it uses apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 with a `versions:` list. That is why it looked correct. The release-2026.08 branch never picked up that change, so every run of this item fails the same way until the job template points at a revision with the v1 manifest (or the fix is backported to release-2026.08).
